subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Construir repertório lexical relativo a verbos regulares e irregulares (formas no passado), preposições de tempo (in, on, at) e conectores (and, but, because, then, so, before, after, entre outros).

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre formas de verbos em past tense regular e irregular em contexto
components.description_en: Distinguish between regular and irregular past tense verb forms in context
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between regular and irregular past tense verb forms in context

components.description_pt: Usar preposições de tempo (in, on, at) corretamente com expressões de tempo passado
components.description_en: Use prepositions of time (in, on, at) correctly with past time expressions
components.cc_component_description: Use frequently occurring prepositions correctly in spoken and written sentences

components.description_pt: Usar conjunções como and, but, or, so e because para conectar ideias em escrita
components.description_en: Use conjunctions such as and, but, or, so, and because to connect ideas in writing
components.cc_component_description: Use conjunctions such as and, but, or, so, and because to connect ideas in writing

components.description_pt: Produzir sentenças usando formas de verbos no passado com preposições de tempo e conectores apropriados
components.description_en: Produce sentences using past verb forms alongside appropriate time prepositions and connectors
components.cc_component_description: Produce complex sentences using a subordinating conjunction and dependent clause

cc_matches.description: Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs (e.g., sat, hid, told).
Use frequently occurring conjunctions (e.g., and, but, or, so, because).
Use frequently occurring prepositions (e.g., during, beyond, toward).
Produce simple, compound, and complex sentences.
